name: Federal-State Case Coordination
detail: Requires BKA level 1 and active RAF cadres. Consolidate federal and state police case files. Each wanted person still at large gains +8 trace, then +1 trace/month for 180 days, capped at 100. Arrests still require the existing investigation process. Cooldown: 180 days.

name: Judicial Review of Security Measures
guard: check_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu > 2 } check_variable = { cwger_rechtsstaat < 98 } check_variable = { cwger_security > 1 }
terms:
35 PP / $0.025bn + $0.002bn/week
Rule of law +3 / Milieu -3 / Security -2
detail: Requires milieu above 2, rule of law below 98 and security above 1. Review intrusive security measures: rule of law +3; milieu −3 immediately and −0.25/month for 180 days; security −2. Reduced intrusive powers constrain security capacity. Cooldown: 180 days.

name: Independent Prison Medical Review
guard: check_variable = { cwger_raf_prisoners > 0 } check_variable = { cwsec_hunger > 9 } check_variable = { cwger_security > 1 }
detail: Requires imprisoned RAF members, hunger-strike pressure above 9 and security above 1. Independent medical scrutiny reduces hunger pressure by 10 and milieu by 2; rule of law +2, security −2. Medical supervision costs $0.003bn/week for 90 days. The chosen prison regime remains in force. Cooldown: 180 days.
